commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a guarded manual AWS/CloudFormation owner, deterministic bootstrap and verification tooling, retained-data teardown, tests, and runbooks for one private FakeCo ARM64 VM.

Reproducibility: not applicable. This PR introduces a new infrastructure ownership capability rather than repairing a reproducible current-main bug.

target.title: feat: add guarded FakeCo AWS owner
target.body:
## Summary

- add a guarded FakeCo-only CloudFormation owner for one private ARM64 ClickClack VM in the dedicated member account
- reuse an explicitly supplied VPC, private subnet, and active egress path; allow TCP 8080 only from approved source security groups
- add protected manual plan/apply/verify/teardown operations with exact account, network, AMI, storage, security-group, KMS, and workload-IAM replay
- add deterministic SSM bootstrap, seed equality, health/readiness, metadata-only metrics, runtime identity, SQLite backup/integrity, restore, and retained-data teardown proof
- bound successful-run disk cleanup to obsolete commit-scoped artifacts after encrypted backup and evidence verification
- document the account foundation, exact Environment inputs, costs, durations, canary handoff, restore procedure, and disposal boundary

Production Cloudflare Worker, Container, Postgres, R2, domains, release, and version paths are unchanged.

## Safety boundary

- `plan` is the default and never executes its change set
- `apply` rejects resource removals and actual or conditional replacement
- no public IP, SSH key, port 22 rule, VPC, subnet, route table, NAT gateway, load balancer, or DNS resource is created
- the instance role is inline-policy-only, permissions-boundary constrained, and limited to SSM plus exact artifact/log/backup/KMS destinations
- KMS preflight checks both the caller's exact effective actions and target-account IAM delegation in the key policy
- shared-bucket artifact, log, and backup prefixes must be pairwise disjoint; duplicate gateway/metrics ingress sources are rejected
- verify and teardown fail closed on live instance, volume, security-group, instance-profile, trust-policy, boundary, tag, and inline-policy drift
- teardown takes a fresh hot backup and encrypted snapshot, retains the root volume and versioned manifest, and contains no implicit data-delete path
- successful cleanup preserves the active release/image/image record and unrecognized operator directories; failure before final backup deletion retains the local backup
- workflow inputs contain identifiers only; no GitHub or application secret values are added

## Validation

Exact candidate: `61f4535f840c55bc0016a71cc4971e3c679cee30` / tree `0d9c740f5248d588bf275166a68e2833a5e9847f`.

Diff: 12 files, 4,366 insertions, 24 deletions; binary diff SHA-256 `e8799bc7b7207b22d235d95e4df386d6e0288ef1fe27bfbacd5070ac32f98e3e`.

- `pnpm check`
- `pnpm docs:site`
- `pnpm coverage` — 86.5%
- `pnpm test:e2e` — 46 passed
- `actionlint .github/workflows/fakeco-aws.yml`
- `shellcheck deploy/fakeco/aws/bootstrap.sh`
- `uvx --from cfn-lint cfn-lint deploy/fakeco/aws/template.json`
- exact-head Docker buildx `linux/arm64` and `linux/amd64` builds, cache-only with no registry output
- Ubuntu 24.04 `linux/arm64` behavior proof — Noble has no `awscli` apt candidate; the checksum-pinned official AWS CLI 2.35.20 archive installs and reports `aarch64`
- AWS CLI 2.35.20 ARM64 argument proof for exact IAM policy simulation and KMS key-policy retrieval
- source-blind AWS guard behavior validation — satisfies contract, confidence 0.99; SSM timeout, snapshot timeout/error states, KMS policy/caller preflight, shared-prefix overlap, and invalid broadening probes covered
- source-blind ingress validation — satisfies contract, confidence 0.98; omitted/distinct sources pass, duplicate source fails without echoing identifiers
- source-blind cleanup validation — satisfies contract, confidence 0.99; active/manual state preserved, stale artifacts removed, failure-path backup retained, and three anti-cheat mutations rejected
- canonical autoreview — the full branch review through `a6e124db50dbe57215a880aa8f24f8303130ef5f` found the two cleanup issues fixed by the final commit; exact final cleanup-commit review is clean with zero actionable findings, confidence 0.94. This split covers the exact branch while respecting the reviewer's 180,000-character safety ceiling.

## Review repairs

- replaced the unavailable Noble `awscli` apt dependency with a versioned official ARM64 archive whose SHA-256 was derived after verifying the AWS CLI Team signature
- accept reserved CloudFormation `aws:` tags during live stack/workload-role replay while retaining exact rejection of every unexpected customer-owned tag
- grant `AWS-RunRemoteScript` its required `s3:ListBucket` only on the artifact bucket and only for the owner-script subprefix; broader prefix and wildcard-resource variants fail profile validation
- bound remote SSM document execution, delivery, and polling to the same 2,400-second budget
- added exact KMS caller simulation and key-policy account-delegation verification, including scoped grant creation only for AWS resources
- reject equal or nested prefixes when destinations reuse a bucket
- replace the short default snapshot waiter with explicit error-aware polling for up to 30 minutes inside a 90-minute job cap
- reject duplicate gateway and metrics security-group ingress sources
- prune stopped project containers, stale commit-scoped images/releases/records, and unused image/build cache only after remote backup metadata and evidence are verified; retain the active commit and failure-path backup
- removed the release-owned changelog edit

Public Model Identifier Gate: **PASS**. The exact candidate diff/tree and source archive, tests, fixtures/snapshots, workflow, generated evidence, structured review reports, built docs/web artifacts, and this public proof have zero blocking unknown identifiers. The canary's public model is documented by [OpenAI](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.5), and the router model-reference syntax is documented by [ClawRouter](https://github.com/openclaw/clawrouter/blob/main/docs/openclaw.md). Generic syntax placeholders, documentation URLs, and generated HTML highlighting fragments were classified as unrelated false positives.

## Remaining live-proof gate

No AWS resource, GitHub Environment, secret, account, release, tag, or registry artifact was created while preparing this PR. A read-only availability audit found no configured `fakeco` Environment and no authenticated member-account identity, so merge remains gated on redacted authenticated account preflight and CloudFormation plan plus live apply/verify, backup/restore, snapshot, and retained-data teardown proof after the service identity and protected Environment are available. The manual workflow must not be dispatched and this PR must not merge until that external gate is satisfied or the owner gives an explicit item-specific waiver.

## Residual risk

The CloudFormation and bootstrap paths are fully linted, simulated, built for both target architectures, behavior-validated, and reviewed, but have not crossed the authenticated member-account boundary. Live IAM/KMS policy evaluation, private-subnet egress, SSM readiness, backup/restore, and retained teardown therefore remain explicit pre-merge gates rather than inferred successes.
